title: Rakshitha Ramraj Upsets Surya Tamiri at Syed Modi International
indian_angle: This report details a significant first-round upset between two prominent Indian women's singles players at a home international tournament.
summary: Rakshitha Ramraj defeated Surya Tamiri in the first round of the Syed Modi India International 2026, a notable win after Tamiri had previously beaten her in the Senior National Championships semifinals.

title: Unnati, Treesa-Gayatri Advance; Prannoy Exits Syed Modi International
indian_angle: Key Indian talents like Unnati Hooda and the women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand progressed, while veteran Prannoy faced an early exit at the home event.
summary: Indian shuttlers Unnati Hooda and the doubles pair Treesa Jolly-Gayatri Gopichand advanced at the Syed Modi India International 2026, though Tanvi Patri retired hurt and Prannoy suffered another first-round defeat.

title: India to Host Thomas and Uber Cup Finals in New Delhi in 2028
indian_angle: India securing the hosting rights for the prestigious Thomas and Uber Cup Finals in 2028 highlights the country's growing stature in global badminton.
summary: New Delhi has been confirmed as the venue for the 2028 Thomas and Uber Cup Finals, a major international team championship, marking a significant event for Indian badminton.

title: BAI Releases Selection Criteria for Asia Mixed Team Championships 2027
indian_angle: Indian fans will be interested in how their favorite players can qualify to represent the nation at the upcoming continental mixed team event.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has published the official selection criteria for the Indian team that will participate in the Badminton Asia Mixed Team Championships in 2027.

title: 88th Senior National Badminton Championships to be Held in Bhubaneswar
indian_angle: This is the premier national tournament where India's top shuttlers compete for national titles, crucial for domestic rankings and recognition.
summary: The 79th Inter State – Inter Zonal & 88th Senior National Badminton Championships 2026 will take place in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, from December 17th to 24th, 2026.
